scope: Broaden downstream consumer and conversion research for the DWG/DXF parity plan. Make FreeCAD importer/exporter identity and settings explicit, separate ODA clean conversion from repair, and reconcile the conditional PLOTSETTINGS DPI route with current local coverage.

method.kind: Current FreeCAD project documentation/source, official ODA File Converter description, Autodesk DXF contract, ACadSharp issue report, and local plan/source/test-owner cross-check
method.evidenceRule: Mutable documentation/source and peer issue reports define candidate routes and test leads only. No runtime acceptance, local defect, or format-support claim is inferred. Repaired output is not a clean conversion pass.

evidence.observed: FreeCAD documentation distinguishes a bundled C++ DXF route from an optional legacy Python route; it says the C++ route is faster but has fewer features, while the Python converter has a separate license and may be downloaded/updated. Preferences can affect annotation, point, paper-space, anonymous-block, scale, object-creation, grouping, joining, color, hatch, spline/ellipse and polyface outcomes. The current C++ importer source records effective settings, but mutable main-source inspection is not a run of a pinned binary.
doesNotEstablish: the behavior of a pinned FreeCAD binary or either backend on this repository's output
that every documented preference exists or behaves identically on every platform/build
semantic preservation from a successful open, object count, or projected mesh
evidence.planUse: At the composed native gate pin the application build/platform, converter, importer backend, add-on digest, explicit preferences, unit scaling and intermediate DXF hash. Classify each source identity as typed, projected, excluded, warning/loss or missing. Keep both importer backends out of per-slice testing.

evidence.topic: FreeCAD TechDraw DXF export is not a modern document-writer comparator
evidence.observed: The documented TechDraw page exporter outputs AC1009/R12 or AC1014/R14 and writes only geometry supported by Import::ImpExpDxfWrite. Its R12 mode can convert spline and ellipse entities to polylines. This is a different workflow from Draft document-level DXF export or the importer used by FreeCAD's DWG converter path.
doesNotEstablish: whole-document or graph-preserving DXF round-trip behavior
evidence.planUse: Exclude TechDraw export/re-import from modern libdxfrw writer acceptance. If TechDraw is an explicit target, label it as an R12/R14 projected-output profile with its own expectations.

evidence.topic: ODA File Converter directory and audit behavior
evidence.observed: The official page describes source and target directories, file filtering, output version/type, recursion, and audit flags; every matching file is loaded and saved, and audit applies repair during load. It lists Linux, macOS ARM64/x64 and Windows packages. ODA is a proprietary external comparator, not an open-source implementation.
doesNotEstablish: that audit-off output is accepted by another independent application
that post-repair output proves the original unmodified conversion was valid
the output version, semantic completeness or geometry without inspecting the actual result
evidence.planUse: At a composed optional gate isolate one input in a fresh source directory and use an empty target directory. Use audit-off for the clean conversion observation. Run audit-on only as a separate diagnostic against a byte-identical copy, preserving diagnostics and input/output hashes. Verify process status, fresh output, actual magic/version and independent reopen.

evidence.topic: Conditional PLOTSETTINGS group 78 and peer layout-loss report
evidence.observed: Autodesk specifies group 78's 100–32767 range as applying only when group 77 selects Custom (5). ACadSharp issue #1184 reports that rejecting inactive stored DPI zero can drop LAYOUT objects in named releases; it is not reproduced here. The existing local 7BM/PLOTSETTINGS test owner already exercises mode 2 with DPI zero separately from Custom-range writer admission. This was a source/test-owner inspection, not a test run.
doesNotEstablish: the correctness of every peer-reported result outside its named releases
layout graph preservation from scalar field retention alone
evidence.planUse: Retain PAR-111/7BM as the only owner; do not add duplicate work. Preserve the inactive zero compatibility control and active Custom bounds, layout owner/dictionary closure, and following-record sentinel when that route changes.

fastPerSliceChecks: relevant LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3 compatibility compile for interface changes
composedConsumerGate: one pinned FreeCAD importer profile and explicit settings; no factorial preference sweep
per-source identity/disposition inventory plus intermediate DXF version and hash
one-input isolated ODA audit-off conversion; optional audit-on repair diagnostic in a separate run
implementationReadiness.fixturePolicy: No downloaded or newly committed drawing fixtures. Use existing repository-owned material or locally generated temporary controls only.
implementationReadiness.cadence: No FreeCAD, ODA, add-on, or peer installation/run per implementation slice; use the composed downstream checkpoint only.
implementationReadiness.nonPromotion: No support claim or external J disposition changes. J256, J260, J268, J284, J293 and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
